results.name: normal stored workspace restore applies writing, builder and deferred view
invalid candidate preserves generation and outstanding work owners
busy restore preserves existing owner and reports no successful restore
accepted restore retires project, intake, pending assignment and hydration owners
late learner-work hydration cannot merge previous workspace responses after restore
late draft hydration cannot overwrite restored source and lesson settings

hydrate read remains valid without a workspace replacement
clear during builder decode releases the old restore lock for a new restore
retired restore finally cannot release a newer in-progress restore
silent unmount invalidation retires restore ownership without lifecycle state writes
